order: Run the WO-11 Band A exercises and audit their outputs. Audit the Conductor's session against the role's guardrails and rule on any violations found, producing a full written audit with dispositions rather than a summary. Live-exercise the P0 substrate end to end and produce a written report of the run. Attempt to live-exercise the Architect role; if the sandbox or environment blocks the attempt, keep the blocked attempt as its own transcript rather than silently dropping it, and record a second transcript if a first attempt has to be redone. Update the band record and status summary with the real per-seat outcomes so the top-line summary matches what was actually exercised rather than a placeholder. Extend the substrate's test suite only as far as needed to support the exercise runs; do not change the production behavior of the substrate itself.
claims: We audited the Conductor's transcript and ruled dispositions for the one violation found, recorded in a 569-line written audit. The P0 substrate was live-exercised end to end and its 340-line report checked in. The Architect exercise was attempted twice; the environment blocked it both times, and both 30-line transcripts are kept as the record. The status summary and band record were updated to the true per-seat outcomes, and the test suite gained 31 lines of exercise-support changes.
